name: Amplitude amplification
description_latex: Amplify a successful classical trial or estimate its success probability; the verifier, trial cost and success probability determine the comparison.
description_text: Amplify a successful classical trial or estimate its success probability; the verifier, trial cost and success probability determine the comparison.

name: Quantum tree search
description_latex: The same branching and pruning rules define the classical tree and the quantum walk. Tree size is an instance-dependent resource.
description_text: The same branching and pruning rules define the classical tree and the quantum walk. Tree size is an instance-dependent resource.

name: Subset dynamic programming
description_latex: Classical preprocessing of small subsets is combined with quantum minimum finding over decompositions; exponential table memory appears in many implementations.
description_text: Classical preprocessing of small subsets is combined with quantum minimum finding over decompositions; exponential table memory appears in many implementations.

name: Quantum walks and span programs
description_latex: Marked subsets, graph witnesses and eigenphase detection yield improvements beyond a direct search over candidate certificates.
description_text: Marked subsets, graph witnesses and eigenphase detection yield improvements beyond a direct search over candidate certificates.

name: Graph input representation
description_latex: Adjacency matrices, adjacency arrays, explicit lists and property-testing promises lead to different classical and quantum complexities.
description_text: Adjacency matrices, adjacency arrays, explicit lists and property-testing promises lead to different classical and quantum complexities.

name: Fourier sampling
description_latex: Periods, hidden subgroups, real periods and hidden shifts connect algebraic number theory with cryptanalysis.
description_text: Periods, hidden subgroups, real periods and hidden shifts connect algebraic number theory with cryptanalysis.

name: Lattice algorithms as subroutines
description_latex: SVP, Gaussian sampling and decoding costs feed into reduction, closest-vector, LWE and SIS algorithms.
description_text: SVP, Gaussian sampling and decoding costs feed into reduction, closest-vector, LWE and SIS algorithms.

name: Code decoding and list matching
description_latex: Information-set search, representations and nearest-neighbor methods connect code-based cryptanalysis with subset sum.
description_text: Information-set search, representations and nearest-neighbor methods connect code-based cryptanalysis with subset sum.

name: Oracle lower bounds
description_latex: The classical lower bound and the quantum upper bound refer to the same queried object and success requirement.
description_text: The classical lower bound and the quantum upper bound refer to the same queried object and success requirement.

name: Conditional lower bounds
description_latex: Set-cover hypotheses, SH/Weak ETH, representation-specific QSETH variants and Hamiltonian complexity attach consequences to hypothetical algorithmic improvements.
description_text: Set-cover hypotheses, SH/Weak ETH, representation-specific QSETH variants and Hamiltonian complexity attach consequences to hypothetical algorithmic improvements.

name: Exact classical counting
description_latex: Fixed-width counting algorithms yield feasibility, witness recovery and optimization through appropriately sized encodings.
description_text: Fixed-width counting algorithms yield feasibility, witness recovery and optimization through appropriately sized encodings.

name: Simulation from counting
description_latex: Feynman path counts and conditional probabilities yield subexponential classical sampling bounds for specified quantum circuit families.
description_text: Feynman path counts and conditional probabilities yield subexponential classical sampling bounds for specified quantum circuit families.

name: Hamiltonian and variational optimization
description_latex: Frustration-free structure, ground-state overlap, spectral gaps, and parameter optimization control the full cost.
description_text: Frustration-free structure, ground-state overlap, spectral gaps, and parameter optimization control the full cost.

name: Constraint-preserving variational circuits
description_latex: One-hot, fixed-Hamming-weight and long/short encodings define feasible subspaces for alternating-operator mixers.
description_text: One-hot, fixed-Hamming-weight and long/short encodings define feasible subspaces for alternating-operator mixers.

name: Variational optimization of discrete objectives
description_latex: Cost estimation, parameter updates and measured classical solutions connect QAOA, VQE, filtering and local-search methods.
description_text: Cost estimation, parameter updates and measured classical solutions connect QAOA, VQE, filtering and local-search methods.

name: Quantum filtering and decoding
description_latex: A classical decoder supplies the coherent uncomputation step in quantum algorithms for restricted short relations; the distribution and number of input vectors determine the comparison.
description_text: A classical decoder supplies the coherent uncomputation step in quantum algorithms for restricted short relations; the distribution and number of input vectors determine the comparison.

name: Recursive Fourier sampling
description_latex: Growing recursion depth gives superpolynomial quantum and classical query costs; the classical lower bound establishes a superpolynomial separation.
description_text: Growing recursion depth gives superpolynomial quantum and classical query costs; the classical lower bound establishes a superpolynomial separation.
